BEGIN

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 RET VARCHAR2(10);
 PROP VARCHAR2(10);
BEGIN
 IF NOT ID_NULL(FIND_FORM('SUPPORT_ENTRY')) THEN
 CLOSE_FORM('SUPPORT_ENTRY');
 END IF;

IF :GLOBAL.EXIT = 2 THEN
 RET := STR.DISPAlert('يجب ادخال بنود للتعهد او حذف التعهد','INFORMATION');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;

ELSIF :GLOBAL.EXIT = 0 THEN
 PROP := GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('SAVE',VISIBLE);

 EXIT_FORM(NO_VALIDATE);

END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-MOUSE-UP
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 vis varchar2(200);
BEGIN

 vis := GET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', visible);

 if vis = 'TRUE' then
 SET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', visible, property_false);
 GO_ITEM(NAME_IN('PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM'));
 COPY('', 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 else
 TMPLT.Populate_Functions ;
 end if;

END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-MOUSE-DOWN
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 vis varchar2(200);
BEGIN

 vis := GET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', visible);

 IF vis = 'FALSE' THEN
 COPY(NAME_IN('SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM'), 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 ADJ_FUNS;
 GO_ITEM('DUMMY');
 END IF;

END;

END IF;

Trigger.Name: KEY-UP

END IF;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
IF TMPLT.USING_KEYB = TRUE THEN
 Set_Item_Property('LSIDE.FN'||TMPLT.CURSOR_AT, VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE, 'STD_NORMAL_FUNCTION');
 Execute_Function('LSIDE.FN'||TMPLT.CURSOR_AT);
 GO_ITEM(NAME_IN('PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM'));
 COPY ('', 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 TMPLT.USING_KEYB := FALSE;
 TMPLT.CURSOR_AT := 0;
END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
V_COUNT NUMBER;
BEGIN
IF :DCLTN_HDR2.DCLTN_ISN IS NULL THEN

 SELECT COUNT(DCLTN_NBR) INTO V_COUNT FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR2.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_NBR = :DCLTN_HDR2.DCLTN_NBR;

 IF V_COUNT > 1 THEN
 :GLOBAL.COUNTER := 1;
 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_PORT_CD := :DCLTN_HDR2.PORT_CD;
 :global.Exec_QRy_Now := 1;
 DECLTN_LOV;

 ELSIF V_COUNT = 1 THEN
 :GLOBAL.COUNTER := 1;
 SELECT DCLTN_ISN,DCLTN_DT INTO :DCLTN_HDR2.DCLTN_ISN,:DCLTN_HDR2.DCLTN_DT FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR2.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_NBR = :DCLTN_HDR2.DCLTN_NBR;

 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_PORT_CD := :DCLTN_HDR2.PORT_CD;
 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_ISN := :DCLTN_HDR2.DCLTN_ISN;
 :global.Exec_QRy_Now := 1;

 END IF;
ELSE
 :GLOBAL.COUNTER := 0;
END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$OLES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF server_err = 1031 THEN
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40508 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية الادخال ' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40509 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية التعديل' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40510 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية الحذف' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
END IF;
 END;
 END;
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_TYPE_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'نوع البيان' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_TIR_HEAD_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'TIR_HQ_SEQ' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_TERMN_USR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز المستخدم', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_STATUS_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'Dcltn Sta Desc' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_SPCL_DEPT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز جهة الأوضاع الخاصه', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_PORT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز الجمرك', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_MNFCT_IMPR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'PORT_CD,MNFCT_NBR' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_INSPECTOR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رقم المعاين - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IMP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رمـز الجمـرك' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_GROUP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'مجموعة المعاينة,رمـز الجمـرك' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_FRIMEX_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'FRGN_IMP_EXP_SEQ' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_EXIT_PORT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز منفذ الخروج', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_DHLOWN_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في مالك بوليصة البريد السريع الدولي - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_CTRY_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في دولة الوصول النهائي', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_BRKRAUTH_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رمـز الجمـرك' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_BKM_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رقم الرخصة - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_AG_AUTH_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'AGNT_ATHRZTN_NBR,PORT_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_AGNT_IMPR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات الشركة الوسيطة - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_AEO_REAS_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات سبب اختيار المشغل الأقتصادى - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* FK - Child record found */
 IF (server_err = 2292) THEN
 IF (err_code = 40509) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

/* CGFK$DEFAULT_WHERE */
/* Add restrictive query on FK items if value(s) entered in non-table items */
/* and/or if there are items which may contain nulls as valid values. Code to */
/* restrict the query is added to the default where clause of the block. */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 block_id Block := find_block('DCLTN_HDR2');
 sub_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 def_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 r_string VARCHAR2(512) := NULL;

 FUNCTION add_and(
 P_WHERE IN VARCHAR2
 ) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 BEGIN
 IF (nvl( length(P_WHERE), 0) != 0) THEN
 RETURN( P_WHERE || ' AND ');
 ELSE
 RETURN( P_WHERE );
 END IF;
 END;

 BEGIN
 IF ( CG$DCLN2261_GLOBALS.DCLTN_HDR2_WHERE = 'first_time') THEN
 CG$DCLN2261_GLOBALS.DCLTN_HDR2_WHERE := get_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE);
 END IF;
 def_where := CG$DCLN2261_GLOBALS.DCLTN_HDR2_WHERE;

 sub_where := NULL;
 r_string := NAME_IN('DCLTN_HDR2.DCLTN_STA_DESC');
 IF (r_string IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 IF substr(r_string, 1,1) IN ('<','>','=') THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(DCLTN_STA_DESC '|| r_string || ')';
 ELSIF substr(r_string, 1,1) ='#' THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(DCLTN_STA_DESC '|| substr(r_string,2) || ')';
 ELSIF instr(r_string, '%') <> 0 THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(DCLTN_STA_DESC LIKE '''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 ELSE
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(DCLTN_STA_DESC ='''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
 IF (sub_where IS NOT NULL) THEN
 def_where := add_and( def_where ) || '((nvl(to_char(DCLTN_STA_CD), ''CG$NULL''), nvl(to_char(DCLTN_TYPE_CD), ''CG$NULL'')) IN '||'(SELECT nvl(to_char(DCLTN_STA_CD), ''CG$NULL''), nvl(to_char(DCLTN_TYPE_CD), ''CG$NULL'') '||'FROM
 DCLTN_STATUS WHERE '|| sub_where || '))';
 END IF;

 set_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE, def_where);

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN VALUE_ERROR THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(33, 'Query criteria too complex - simplify and re-query'), 'E', 'OFG', 33);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END;
END;

 INTRFACE.MAKE_FIELD_ENTRABLE('DCLTN_TYPE_CD', FALSE);
END IF;

 :DCLTN_STA_CD := CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DSI_INSP');

 ELSE
 :DCLTN_STA_CD := CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DSI_FILL');

 END IF;

 :DCLTN_STA_CD := CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DSX_REV');

 ELSE
 :DCLTN_STA_CD := CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DSX_INIT');
 --:U_DCLTN_STATUS := :DCLTN_STA_CD;
 END IF;
END IF;

 WHERE DCLTN_TYPE_CD = :DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 AND DCLTN_STA_CD = :DCLTN_STA_CD
 AND REC_STATUS = 1;

 EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN NULL;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 V_EXIST NUMBER;
BEGIN

 IF :MANIFESTS.MFST_NBR IS NOT NULL THEN

 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_EXIST FROM MANIFESTS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :MANIFESTS.PORT_CD
 AND SHPMT_TYPE = :MANIFESTS.SHPMT_TYPE
 AND MFST_NBR = :MANIFESTS.MFST_NBR
 AND MFST_YEAR = :MANIFESTS.MFST_YEAR
 AND ROWNUM < 2;

 IF V_EXIST > 0 THEN

 :GLOBAL.PORT_CD := :MANIFESTS.PORT_CD;
 :GLOBAL.SHPMT_TYPE := :MANIFESTS.SHPMT_TYPE;
 :global.MFST_NBR := :MANIFESTS.MFST_NBR ;
 :global.MFST_YEAR := :MANIFESTS.MFST_YEAR ;
 :global.Exec_Query_Now := 1;
 :GLOBAL.clr_form_Now := 0;

 ELSIF V_EXIST = 0 THEN
 :GLOBAL.PORT_CD := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.SHPMT_TYPE := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.MFST_NBR := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.MFST_YEAR := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.Exec_Query_Now := 0;
 :GLOBAL.clr_form_Now := 1;
 END IF;

 ELSE
 IF :MANIFESTS.MFST_YEAR < TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY')) THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('يجب أن تكون سنة المنافست السنة الحالية','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$OLES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF server_err = 1031 THEN
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40508 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية الادخال ' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40509 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية التعديل' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40510 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية الحذف' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
END IF;
 END;
 END;
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'MAN_SHAG_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات وكيل الشحن الجوي', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'MAN_SDP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('رمز الجمرك غير صحيح - إستخدم القائمة لإختيار رمز جمرك صحيح', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'MAN_FP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('بيانات الجمرك غير صحيحة - إستخدم القائمة لإختيار جمرك صحيح', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* FK - Child record found */
 IF (server_err = 2292) THEN
 IF (err_code = 40509) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
 END;
 END IF;
END;

 END IF;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$OLES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF server_err = 1031 THEN
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40508 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية الادخال ' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40509 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية التعديل' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40510 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية الحذف' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
END IF;
 END;
 END;
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'BILL_STMT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('بيان الإستيراد هذا غير موجود - إستخدم القائمة لإختيار بيان موجود', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'BILL_SHAG_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'SHPG_AGNT_NBR' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'BILL_SD_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('البيان الإحصائي هذا غير موجود - إستخدم القائمة لإختيار بيان موجود', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'BILL_SDP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('رمز الجمرك غير صحيح - إستخدم القائمة لإختيار رمز جمرك صحيح', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'BILL_PRT_TYP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'FINAL_PORT_TYPE_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'BILL_MD_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا المانفيست غير موجودة - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'BILL_IMP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'IMPR_NBR,PORT_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'BILL_FP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز جمرك الوصول النهائي - إستخدم القائمة لإخيار رمز جمرك صحيح', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'BILL_CUR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'BILL_CURRENCY' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'BILL_CT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'OWNER_CITY_CODE,FINAL_CTRY_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'BILL_CTRY_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('رمز الدولة غير صحيح - إستخدم القائمة لإختيار رمز صحيح', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'BILL_CR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز الشركة الناقلة - إستخدم القائمة لإختيار رمز شركة صحيح', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'BILL_BILL_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'CARR_PREFIX,MASTER_BILL_NBR,PORT_CD,BILL_DT' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'BILL_AGCRCY_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في سعر العملة - إستخدم القائمة لإختيار سعر العملة الصحيح', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* FK - Child record found */
 IF (server_err = 2292) THEN
 IF (err_code = 40510) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'PKGD_BILL_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(5, 'Cannot delete <p1> while dependent <p2> exists', 'البوالص','أصناف البوالص' ), 'E', 'OFG', 5);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'BLD_BILL_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(5, 'Cannot delete <p1> while dependent <p2> exists', 'البوالص','أجزاء البوالص' ), 'E', 'OFG', 5);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'A_DLVY_BILL_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(5, 'Cannot delete <p1> while dependent <p2> exists', 'البوالص','أذن التسليم' ), 'E', 'OFG', 5);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'BLI_BILL_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(5, 'Cannot delete <p1> while dependent <p2> exists', 'البوالص','نتائج عملية فحص البوالص' ), 'E', 'OFG', 5);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'BILL_BILL_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(5, 'Cannot delete <p1> while dependent <p2> exists', 'البوالص','البوالص' ), 'E', 'OFG', 5);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'TRSTB_BILL_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(5, 'Cannot delete <p1> while dependent <p2> exists', 'البوالص','بوالص الترانزيت' ), 'E', 'OFG', 5);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 ELSIF (err_code = 40509) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: PRE-DELETE
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGRI$CASCADE_DELETE */
/* This performs referential integrity checks/updates prior to the */
/* deletion of a row. It first performs any block deletion checks, */
/* and then any database updates required due to the delete. */
BEGIN
 BEGIN
 CGRI$CHK_BILLS(
 FALSE /* IN : Check FKs validated in BOTH (client/server)? */
 ,:BILLS.CARR_PREFIX /* IN : Item value */
 ,:BILLS.PORT_CD /* IN : Item value */
 ,:BILLS.BILL_NBR /* IN : Item value */
 ,:BILLS.BILL_DT ); /* IN : Item value */
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-DELREC
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGRI$CHECK_ON_DELETE */
/* This checks that the user is allowed to delete the current row, */
/* prior to removing it, according to any referential integrity */
/* rules held in the database design. */
BEGIN
 BEGIN
 CGRI$CHK_BILLS(
 TRUE /* IN : Check FKs validated in BOTH (client/server)? */
 ,:BILLS.CARR_PREFIX /* IN : Item value */
 ,:BILLS.PORT_CD /* IN : Item value */
 ,:BILLS.BILL_NBR /* IN : Item value */
 ,:BILLS.BILL_DT ); /* IN : Item value */
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
 END;
END;

/* CGGN$KEY_DELREC */
/* Perform the key's standard functionality */

 CGHP$CALL_MS_HELP(

 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
 END;
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 V_APL_DT DATE;
 V_EFF_DT DATE;
 V_STATUS VARCHAR2(2000);
 V_RET NUMBER;
 V_DCLTN_PAID NUMBER:= 1;

BEGIN


 V_APL_DT := NVL(:DCLTN_HDR2.DCLTN_DT,HIJDATE.Cur_Hij_Date);

 V_RET := TARIFF.TRF_ITEM_STAT(:DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_CD, V_APL_DT, V_EFF_DT, V_STATUS,2,V_DCLTN_PAID);
 IF V_STATUS IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_STATUS, 'INFORMATION');
 END IF;

 IF V_RET <> 1 THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;


 :DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_DT := V_EFF_DT;

 :DCLTN_ITEMS.BRKR_TARIFF_CD := :DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_CD;
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.BRKR_TARIFF_DT := V_EFF_DT;
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.INS_TARIFF_CD := :DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_CD;
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.INS_TARIFF_DT := V_EFF_DT;





 SELECT TRF_INTL_UNIT
 INTO :DCLTN_ITEMS.INTL_MSR_UNIT
 FROM TARIFF_DETAILS
 WHERE HRMNZD_CODE = :DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_CD
 AND EFF_DATE = V_EFF_DT;


END;

 IF Get_Record_Property(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_RECORD,:SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK,STATUS) IN ('NEW', 'INSERT') THEN
 IF GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK, INSERT_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, ENABLED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, INSERT_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 V_DISP_LOV := TRUE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 IF GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK, UPDATE_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, ENABLED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, UPDATE_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 V_DISP_LOV := TRUE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
ELSE
 IF GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK, QUERY_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, QUERYABLE) = 'TRUE' THEN
 V_DISP_LOV := TRUE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END IF;
IF NOT V_DISP_LOV THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;

END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_XRD_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات نوع الإعفاء المستخدم - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_SDP_FK3') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز الجمرك - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_SDP_FK2') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز جمرك الإستيراد للصنف المعاد تصديره', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_SDP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز الجمرك - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_RETITM_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ فى االرابطة بين أصناف البيان و أصناف محضر الحجز', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_RACT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'RACT_ACTION_NBR,PORT_CD,RACT_RET_BILL_NBR,RACT_AC' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_MU_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز وحدة القياس علي الفاتورة - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_LSITMS_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ فى بيانات المبيعات', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_LFTITM_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ فى االرابطة بين أصناف البيان و أصناف محضر المتروكات', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_LACIT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'LACIT_ACTION_CD,LACIT_LFT_ITEM_NBR,PORT_CD,LACIT_' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_INS_TRF_EXP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'INS_TARIFF_CD,INS_TARIFF_ANAL_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_INS_TRFD_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بند التعرفة الجمركية - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_IMU_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز وحدة القياس الدولية - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_ICA_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'ICA_IDNT_ISN' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_GCC_EXM_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'PORT_CD,GCC_EXM_A_ISN,GCC_EXM_B_SEQ,GCC_EXM_B_ITE' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_FINAL_TRF_EXP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'FINAL_TARIFF_CD,FINAL_TARIFF_ANAL_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_FINAL_TRFD_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بند التعرفة الجمركية - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_EXMTN_TYP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز نوع الإعفاء', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_EXMTN_DTL_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات الإعفاء المستخدم - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_EXMTN_DCREE_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات نوع الإعفاء المستخدم - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_DIR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات سبب التأمين - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_DCLTN_INV_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات الفاتورة - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_DCLTN_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات البيان الجمركي', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_DCLTNT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في نوع البيان الجمركي للصنف المعاد تصديره', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_DAPPL_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات الإعفاء الدبلوماسي - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_CTRY_FK2') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('يجب اختيار بلد الشراء', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_CTRY_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز الدولة - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_BRKR_TRF_XP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'BRKR_TARIFF_CD,BRKR_TARIFF_ANAL_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_BRKR_TRFD_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بند التعرفة الجمركية - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_APPRV_USR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز المستعمل', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_AM_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'AGRMNT_NO,AGRMNT_MEMBER_ISN' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* FK - Child record found */
 IF (server_err = 2292) THEN
 IF (err_code = 40509) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'DTSH_DCLTN_IT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(4, 'Cannot update <p1> while dependent <p2> exists', 'DCLTN_ITEMS','DCLTN_ITEM_SUB_HRMNZ' ), 'E', 'OFG', 4);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: PRINT_REPORT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 PROCEDURE PRINT_REPORT(FN In VARCHAR2, PL_ID PARAMLIST, V_REP_FRM_FLG NUMBER, V_REP_PRNT_FLG NUMBER) IS
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 FOUND_CD BOOLEAN := FALSE;
 ROW_COUNT NUMBER := 1;


 V_MOD_ID NUMBER;
 V_MSG VARCHAR2(500);
 V_PATH VARCHAR2(200);
 V_CALLED_FORM VARCHAR2(200);
 V_MOD_NAME VARCHAR2(200);
 V_SEQ_NO NUMBER;
 V_SYS_TYPE NUMBER;
 V_FILE_NAME VARCHAR2(200);
/*
 cursor c_modudle_parameter(p_mid NUMBER)
 is select VAR_NAME ,VAR_VALUE
 from sc_port_setting
 where PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND sysobj_id = p_mid;
*/
 BEGIN
/* IF FN IS NOT NULL THEN
 WHILE ROW_COUNT <= TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS_COUNT AND NOT FOUND_CD LOOP
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD LIKE FN THEN
 FOUND_CD := TRUE;
 ELSE
 ROW_COUNT := ROW_COUNT + 1;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 IF FOUND_CD THEN
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT SYS_OS_FILE_NAME, SYS_ANAME, SYS_TYPE, SEQ_NO
 INTO V_FILE_NAME, V_MOD_NAME, V_SYS_TYPE, V_SEQ_NO
 FROM sc_system_objects
 WHERE SYS_TYPE = 6
 AND SYS_STATUS = 1
 AND SYSOBJ_ID = TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('الشاشة المطلوبة غير معرفة داخل نظام الأمن' ,'ERROR');
 END;

 IF V_FILE_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_WS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_WS_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_PORT_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_GROUP_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_GROUP_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_USER_TYPE', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_USER_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_JOB_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_JOB_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_CLASS_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_MODULE_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,V_MOD_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BRKR_PORT_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BRKR_NBR' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_LIC_TYPE' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_LIC_TYPE);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BANK_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BANK_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BANK_BRNCH_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BANK_BRNCH_CD);

 DEFAULT_VALUE('0', 'GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_SYS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_REP_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,V_SEQ_NO);

 for i in c_modudle_parameter(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID)
 loop
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,i.VAR_NAME,TEXT_PARAMETER,i.VAR_VALUE);
 end loop;

 V_CALLED_FORM := TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).PATH;
 IF SUBSTR(V_CALLED_FORM, LENGTH(V_CALLED_FORM), 1) <> '\' THEN
 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||'\';
 END IF;


 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||V_FILE_NAME;
 IF V_REP_FRM_FLG = 1 THEN
 CALL_FORM(V_CALLED_FORM,
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
 ELSIF V_REP_PRNT_FLG = 1 THEN
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'PRINTER');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');

ProgramUnit.Name: EXECUTE_FUNCTION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 PROCEDURE Execute_Function(FN In VARCHAR2) IS
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 FOUND_CD BOOLEAN := FALSE;
 ROW_COUNT NUMBER := 1;
 CD_TITLE VARCHAR2(200);
 RET NUMBER;
 V_MSG VARCHAR2(2000);

 V_MOD_ID NUMBER;
 V_PATH VARCHAR2(200);
 pl_id ParamList;
 V_CALLED_FORM VARCHAR2(200);
 V_MOD_NAME VARCHAR2(200);
 V_SEQ_NO NUMBER;
 V_SYS_TYPE NUMBER;
 V_FILE_NAME VARCHAR2(200);

 cursor c_modudle_parameter(p_mid NUMBER)
 is select VAR_NAME ,VAR_VALUE
 from sc_port_setting
 where PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD -- NALSALEH CENTRALIZED PROJECT
 AND sysobj_id = p_mid;

 BEGIN
 IF FN IS NOT NULL THEN
 SET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 CD_TITLE := NAME_IN(FN);

 WHILE ROW_COUNT <= TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS_COUNT AND NOT FOUND_CD LOOP
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).TITLE LIKE CD_TITLE AND TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).ACT = 1 THEN
 FOUND_CD := TRUE;
 ELSE
 ROW_COUNT := ROW_COUNT + 1;
 END IF;

 END LOOP;

 IF FOUND_CD THEN
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT SYS_OS_FILE_NAME, SYS_ANAME, SYS_TYPE, SEQ_NO
 INTO V_FILE_NAME, V_MOD_NAME, V_SYS_TYPE, V_SEQ_NO
 FROM sc_system_objects
 WHERE SYS_TYPE IN (5,6)
 AND SYS_STATUS = 1
 AND SYSOBJ_ID = TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('الشاشة المطلوبة غير معرفة داخل نظام الأمن او انها غير فعالة' ,'ERROR');
 END;

 IF V_FILE_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('TMPLT_MOD_CALL');
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('TMPLT_MOD_CALL');
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list TMPLT_MOD_CALL IN TEMPLATE ', 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_WS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_WS_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_PORT_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_GROUP_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_GROUP_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_USER_TYPE', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_USER_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_JOB_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_JOB_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_CLASS_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_MODULE_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,V_MOD_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BRKR_PORT_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BRKR_NBR' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_LIC_TYPE' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_LIC_TYPE);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BANK_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BANK_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BANK_BRNCH_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BANK_BRNCH_CD);
 for i in c_modudle_parameter(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID)
 loop
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,i.VAR_NAME,TEXT_PARAMETER,i.VAR_VALUE);
 end loop;

 EXEC_FUNS(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD);
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('TMPLT_MOD_CALL');
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 V_CALLED_FORM := TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).PATH;
 IF SUBSTR(V_CALLED_FORM, LENGTH(V_CALLED_FORM), 1) <> '\' THEN
 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||'\';
 END IF;


 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||V_FILE_NAME;
 IF V_SYS_TYPE = 5 THEN
 CALL_FORM(V_CALLED_FORM,
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
 ELSE
 DEFAULT_VALUE('0', 'GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_SYS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_REP_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,V_SEQ_NO);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,:GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ ||'-'||V_SEQ_NO);
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).FORM_FLAG = 1 THEN
 CALL_FORM(V_CALLED_FORM,
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
 ELSIF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).PRNT_FLAG = 1 THEN
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'PRINTER');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');

 IF ADJ_PRN.ADJ_REPORT_PRINTER(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID, V_MSG) = TRUE THEN
 REP.Run_Product(REPORTS,V_CALLED_FORM,SYNCHRONOUS,BATCH,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,NULL);
 ELSIF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن ضبط الطابعة للتقرير', 'ERROR');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 IF ADJ_PRN.ADJ_REPORT_PRINTER(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID, V_MSG) = TRUE THEN
 REP.Run_Product(REPORTS,V_CALLED_FORM,SYNCHRONOUS,RUNTIME,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,NULL);
 ELSIF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن ضبط الطابعة للتقرير', 'ERROR');
 END IF;

 END IF;
 END IF;

 :PARAMETER.P_CTRL_LAST_EXEC_CD := TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD;
 EXEC_FUNS('MOD_CALL_BACK');
 :PARAMETER.P_CTRL_LAST_EXEC_CD := NULL;
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 END IF;
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||'TMPLT_MOD_CALL'||' already exists!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 RET := STR.DISPALERT('الشاشة المطلوبة غير معرفة داخل نظام الأمن او انها غير فعالة' ,'ERROR');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 EXEC_FUNS(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD);
 :PARAMETER.P_CTRL_LAST_EXEC_CD := TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD;
 EXEC_FUNS('MOD_CALL_BACK');
 :PARAMETER.P_CTRL_LAST_EXEC_CD := NULL;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 RET := STR.DISPALERT('خطأ داخلي في أكواد الوظائف - إتصل بالمساندة الفنية' ,'ERROR');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END Execute_Function;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGDV$POPULATE_DYNAMIC_LISTS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGDV$POPULATE_DYNAMIC_LISTS */
PROCEDURE CGDV$POPULATE_DYNAMIC_LISTS IS
/* Read each lists values from its record group and populate the list */
 temp NUMBER; /* Return value of populate_group call */
 rg_id RECORDGROUP; /* Return value of populate_group call */
BEGIN
 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_LOW_VALUE, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''DCLTN_PMT_METHOD'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('DCLTN_HDR2.PMT_METHOD', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_LOW_VALUE, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''TERMN_RSN'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('DCLTN_HDR2.TERMN_RSN', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_LOW_VALUE, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''SHPMT TYPE'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('MANIFESTS.SHPMT_TYPE', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_LOW_VALUE, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''SHPMT TYPE'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('BILLS.SHPMT_TYPE', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_LOW_VALUE, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''MANIFEST TYPE'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('BILLS.MFST_TYPE', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_LOW_VALUE, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''BILL STATUS'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('BILLS.BILL_STATUS', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_LOW_VALUE, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''BILL PRE TYPE'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('BILLS.BILL_PRE_TYPE', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_LOW_VALUE, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''DUTY_TYPE'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('DCLTN_ITEMS.DUTY_TYPE', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGFK$CHK_DCLTN_HDR2_DCLTN_TYPE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGFK$CHK_DCLTN_HDR2_DCLTN_TYPE */
PROCEDURE CGFK$CHK_DCLTN_HDR2_DCLTN_TYPE(
 P_DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN NUMBER) IS /* Value in Item :DCLTN_HDR2.DCLTN_TYPE_CD. */
/* Validate foreign key value/query lookup data. */
 CG$DUMMY VARCHAR2(1);
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 CURSOR C IS
 SELECT '1'
 FROM DCLTN_TYPES
 WHERE TYPE_ID = P_DCLTN_TYPE_CD;
 BEGIN
 OPEN C;
 FETCH C
 INTO CG$DUMMY;
 IF C%NOTFOUND THEN
 CLOSE C;
 RAISE NO_DATA_FOUND;
 END IF;
 CLOSE C;
 END;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGFK$QRY_DCLTN_HDR2_DCLTN_STAT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGFK$QRY_DCLTN_HDR2_DCLTN_STAT */
PROCEDURE CGFK$QRY_DCLTN_HDR2_DCLTN_STAT(
 P_DCLTN_TYPE_NAME IN OUT VARCHAR2 /* Value in Item :DCLTN_HDR2.DCLTN_TYPE_NAME. */
 ,P_DCLTN_STA_DESC IN OUT VARCHAR2 /* Value in Item :DCLTN_HDR2.DCLTN_STA_DESC. */
 ,P_DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN NUMBER /* Value in Item :DCLTN_HDR2.DCLTN_TYPE_CD. */
 ,P_DCLTN_STA_CD IN NUMBER ) IS /* Value in Item :DCLTN_HDR2.DCLTN_STA_CD. */
/* Query foreign key value/query lookup data. */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 CURSOR C IS
 SELECT DCLTN_ST.DCLTN_STA_DESC
 ,DCLTNT.TYPE_NAME
 FROM DCLTN_STATUS DCLTN_ST
 ,DCLTN_TYPES DCLTNT
 WHERE (DCLTN_ST.DCLTN_STA_CD = P_DCLTN_STA_CD OR
 (DCLTN_ST.DCLTN_STA_CD IS NULL AND
 P_DCLTN_STA_CD IS NULL ))
 AND (DCLTN_ST.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = P_DCLTN_TYPE_CD OR

ProgramUnit.Name: CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO */
FUNCTION CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(
 P_SERVER_ERR IN NUMBER /* Server error message */
 ,P_SERVER_MSG IN VARCHAR2) /* Server error number */
RETURN BOOLEAN IS
/* Check and report Primary/Unique Key, Check Constraint and User */
/* Defined Constraint violations */
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61); /* Violated constraint */
BEGIN
 /* Check if the error code is one we are interested in */
 IF ( NOT (P_SERVER_ERR IN (1, 2290) OR
 (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) ) )
 THEN
 RETURN( FALSE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with user defined errors */
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(''||CGTE$STRIP_FIRST_ERROR(P_SERVER_MSG), 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 RETURN( TRUE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with Primary/Unique Key and Check Constraint violations */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(P_SERVER_MSG);
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR = 1) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل موجود بالفعل - أعد إدخال بيانات جديدة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'IMP_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل مدخل سابقاً - أعد ادخال البيانات', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'IMP_BUSID_UK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل مدخل سابقاً - أعد ادخال البيانات', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SDP_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز المنفذ' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DG_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'تعريف المجموعة,رمز الجمرك' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_STATUS_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل موجود بالفعل - أعد إدخال بيانات جديدة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTNT_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل موجود بالفعل - أعد إدخال بيانات جديدة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'CTRY_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز الدولة' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'MAN_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هل السجل مدخل مسبقاً - أعد إدخال سجل جديد', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'BILL_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هل السجل مدخل مسبقاً - أعد إدخال سجل جديد', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'STMT_IT_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل موجود بالفعل - أعد إدخال بيانات جديدة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_UK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'PORT_CD,ITEM_ISN,FINAL_TARIFF_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 ELSIF (P_SERVER_ERR = 2290) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'VALID_DATE_NUMBER') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في عملية ترقيم البيان الجمركي - يجب وجود رقم وتاريخ في نفس الوقت', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SHPMT_TYPE_CHECK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('بيانات أحد أنواع المانفيست غير مكتملة أو بها بيانات إضافية لنوع آخر', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'BILL_TYPE_CHECK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('بيانات البوالص غير متناسبة مع نوع الشحن', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'BILL_SHPMT_TYPE_CHECK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(14, 'Invalid combination of <p1>', 'نوع الشحن,النوع المبدئي للبوليصة' ), 'E', 'OFG', 14);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN( TRUE );
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGLY$DISPLAY_CANVASES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGLY$DISPLAY_CANVASES */
PROCEDURE CGLY$DISPLAY_CANVASES(
 P_CANVAS_LIST IN OUT VARCHAR2 /* List of displayed canvases */
 ,P_CURRENT_CANVAS IN VARCHAR2 /* Current canvas */
 ,P_BASE_CANVAS IN VARCHAR2) IS /* Base canvas */
/* Display the current canvas plus any others in the canvas list */
 canvas_list VARCHAR2(255); /* List of displayed canvases */
 canvas_to_raise VARCHAR2(255); /* Canvas to raise to the top */
BEGIN
 IF ( P_CURRENT_CANVAS = P_BASE_CANVAS) THEN
 P_CANVAS_LIST := P_CURRENT_CANVAS || ',';
 ELSE
 P_CANVAS_LIST := replace(P_CANVAS_LIST, P_CURRENT_CANVAS || ',');
 IF ( get_view_property(P_BASE_CANVAS, VISIBLE) = 'FALSE') THEN
 canvas_list := P_CANVAS_LIST;
 WHILE (canvas_list IS NOT NULL) LOOP
 canvas_to_raise := substr(canvas_list, 1, instr(canvas_list, ','));
 canvas_list := replace(canvas_list, canvas_to_raise);
 CGLY$RAISE_CANVAS(rtrim(canvas_to_raise, ','));
 END LOOP;
 END IF;
 P_CANVAS_LIST := P_CANVAS_LIST || P_CURRENT_CANVAS || ',';
 END IF;
 CGLY$RAISE_CANVAS(P_CURRENT_CANVAS);
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGLY$GET_RELATED_CANVASES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGLY$GET_RELATED_CANVASES */
PROCEDURE CGLY$GET_RELATED_CANVASES(
 P_CURRENT_CANVAS IN OUT VARCHAR2 /* Current canvas */
 ,P_BASE_CANVAS IN OUT VARCHAR2) IS /* Base canvas */
/* Find the canvases associated with the current canvas and record which */
/* base canvas is displayed in each window */
BEGIN
 IF ( P_CURRENT_CANVAS = 'CG$SPREAD_TABLE_1') THEN
 P_CURRENT_CANVAS := 'CG$PAGE_1';
 END IF;
 /* CFLT */
 P_BASE_CANVAS := P_CURRENT_CANVAS;
 IF (get_view_property(P_CURRENT_CANVAS, WINDOW_NAME) = 'CGSO$WINDOW_1') THEN
 IF (:CG$CTRL.CG$WINDOWCGSO$WINDOW_1_PAGE IS NULL OR :CG$CTRL.CG$WINDOWCGSO$WINDOW_1_PAGE != P_BASE_CANVAS) THEN
 set_view_property('CG$SPREAD_TABLE_1', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_OFF);
 END IF;
 :CG$CTRL.CG$WINDOWCGSO$WINDOW_1_PAGE := P_BASE_CANVAS;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGLY$RAISE_CANVAS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGLY$RAISE_CANVAS */
PROCEDURE CGLY$RAISE_CANVAS(
 P_CANVAS IN VARCHAR2) IS /* Current canvas */
/* Raise the current canvas, plus any dependant canvases to the top */
BEGIN
 set_view_property(P_CANVAS, VISIBLE, PROPERTY_ON);
 IF ( P_CANVAS = 'CG$PAGE_1') THEN
 set_view_property('CG$SPREAD_TABLE_1', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_ON);
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGLY$CANVAS_MANAGEMENT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGLY$CANVAS_MANAGEMENT */
PROCEDURE CGLY$CANVAS_MANAGEMENT IS
/* Top level canvas management procedure */
 current_canvas VARCHAR2(61) := get_item_property(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, ITEM_CANVAS);
 base_canvas VARCHAR2(61);
 canvas_list VARCHAR2(255);
BEGIN
 IF ( (:CG$CTRL.CG$LAST_CANVAS IS NULL) OR (:CG$CTRL.CG$LAST_CANVAS != current_canvas) ) THEN
 :CG$CTRL.CG$LAST_CANVAS := current_canvas;
 set_window_property( get_view_property( current_canvas, WINDOW_NAME ), VISIBLE, PROPERTY_ON);
 CGLY$GET_RELATED_CANVASES(current_canvas, base_canvas);
 IF ( base_canvas = 'CG$PAGE_1') THEN
 canvas_list := :CG$CTRL.CG$PAGE_1_LIST;
 END IF;
 CGLY$DISPLAY_CANVASES(canvas_list, current_canvas, base_canvas);
 IF ( base_canvas = 'CG$PAGE_1') THEN
 :CG$CTRL.CG$PAGE_1_LIST := canvas_list;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: UPDATE_DCLTN_INVOICE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE UPDATE_DCLTN_INVOICE (V_PORT_CD NUMBER,V_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER,V_COMMIT BOOLEAN:=FALSE) IS
 V_TOTAL_EXPS NUMBER (14,3);
 V_ITEMS_CNT NUMBER;
BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_ITEMS_CNT
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN= V_DCLTN_ISN;

 SELECT NVL(SUM(INV_COST),0)
 INTO V_TOTAL_EXPS
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN= V_DCLTN_ISN;


 UPDATE DCLTN_INVOICES
 SET TOTAL_EXPS = V_TOTAL_EXPS
 ,ITEMS_CNT = V_ITEMS_CNT
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN= V_DCLTN_ISN;

 IF V_COMMIT = TRUE THEN
 FORMS_DDL('COMMIT');
 END IF;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: UPDATE_BILL_ITEMS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE UPDATE_BILL_ITEMS IS
BEGIN
 UPDATE BILL_ITEMS
 SET PKG_TYPE_CD = :PKG_TYPE,
 ITEM_MARK = :ITEM_MARK,
 ITEM_QTY = :INV_QTY,
 ITEM_WT = :INV_QTY,
 ITEM_DESC =:DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_DESC
 WHERE

ProgramUnit.Name: LOCAL_GET_DUTY
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE LOCAL_GET_DUTY(CIF_VAL OUT NUMBER, DUTY_VAL OUT NUMBER) IS
 INV_REC DUTY.T_DCLTN_INVOICES_DUTY;
 LIN DUTY.T_DCLTN_ITEMS_DUTY;
 CALC_DT DATE;
 V_FINAL_CTRY_CD NUMBER;
 V_MSG_TXT VARCHAR2(2000);
 v_cif_val NUMBER ; 
 V_TEMP NUMBER;
 V_TRF_CALC_DT DATE;

 CURSOR DCLTN_INV IS
 SELECT PORT_CD, INV_ISN, INV_SEQ, INV_NBR, INV_TYPE, DCLTN_ISN, ITEMS_CNT, SHPMT_EXPS, SHPMT_CURCY_CD, SHPMT_EXPS_PCTG, INS_EXPS, INS_CURCY_CD, OTHER_EXPS, OTHER_CURCY_CD, AIR_SHPMT_EXPS, DISC_PCTG, TOTAL_EXPS, INV_CURCY_CD, SRCE_NBR, BILL_CARGO_EXPS, BILL_CURCY_CD
 FROM DCLTN_INVOICES
 WHERE PORT_CD =
:DCLTN_HDR2.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR2.DCLTN_ISN;

 REC_COUNT NUMBER;
 V_TOTAL_EXPS NUMBER(14,3) := 0.0;

BEGIN
 CIF_VAL := NULL;
 DUTY_VAL := NULL;
 -- FILL THE RECORD FROM THE CURSOR
 UPDATE_DCLTN_INVOICE (:DCLTN_HDR2.PORT_CD ,:DCLTN_HDR2.DCLTN_ISN,FALSE );
 FOR DCLTN_INVOICES IN DCLTN_INV LOOP
 INV_REC.INV_TYPE := DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_TYPE ;
 INV_REC.SHPMT_EXPS := DCLTN_INVOICES.SHPMT_EXPS ;
 INV_REC.SHPMT_CURCY_CD := DCLTN_INVOICES.SHPMT_CURCY_CD ;
 INV_REC.SHPMT_EXPS_PCTG := DCLTN_INVOICES.SHPMT_EXPS_PCTG;
 INV_REC.INS_EXPS := DCLTN_INVOICES.INS_EXPS ;
 INV_REC.INS_CURCY_CD := DCLTN_INVOICES.INS_CURCY_CD ;
 INV_REC.OTHER_EXPS := DCLTN_INVOICES.OTHER_EXPS ;
 INV_REC.OTHER_CURCY_CD := DCLTN_INVOICES.OTHER_CURCY_CD ;
 INV_REC.AIR_SHPMT_EXPS := DCLTN_INVOICES.AIR_SHPMT_EXPS ;
 INV_REC.DISC_PCTG := DCLTN_INVOICES.DISC_PCTG ;
 INV_REC.TOTAL_EXPS := DCLTN_INVOICES.TOTAL_EXPS ;
 INV_REC.INV_CURCY_CD := DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_CURCY_CD ;
 END LOOP;

 -- FILL THE RECORD FROM THE BLOCK
 LIN.PORT_CD := :DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD ;
 LIN.ITEM_ISN := :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN ;
 LIN.INV_ISN := :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_ISN ;
 LIN.BRKR_TARIFF_CD := :DCLTN_ITEMS.BRKR_TARIFF_CD ;
 LIN.BRKR_TARIFF_DT := :DCLTN_ITEMS.BRKR_TARIFF_DT ;
 LIN.FINAL_TARIFF_CD := :DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_CD ;
 LIN.FINAL_TARIFF_DT := :DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_DT ;
 LIN.DUTY_TYPE := :DCLTN_ITEMS.DUTY_TYPE ;
 LIN.PNLTY_RQR := :DCLTN_ITEMS.PNLTY_RQR ;
 LIN.TRF_UNIT_QTY := :DCLTN_ITEMS.TRF_UNIT_QTY ;
 LIN.MIN_DUTY_UNIT_QTY := :DCLTN_ITEMS.MIN_DUTY_UNIT_QTY ;
 LIN.ADD_FEE_UNIT_QTY := :DCLTN_ITEMS.ADD_FEE_UNIT_QTY ;
 LIN.INV_COST := :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_COST ;
 LIN.CIF_COST := :DCLTN_ITEMS.CIF_COST ;
 LIN.CSTMS_COST := :DCLTN_ITEMS.CSTMS_COST ;
 LIN.GROSS_WT := :DCLTN_ITEMS.GROSS_WT ;
 LIN.ORGNL_DUTY := :DCLTN_ITEMS.ORGNL_DUTY ;
 LIN.EXMTD_DUTY := :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTD_DUTY ;

 CALC_DT := HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE;
 V_TRF_CALC_DT := NVL(:DCLTN_HDR2.DCLTN_DT, CALC_DT);

 CIF_VAL := DUTY.GET_LINE_CIF (:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE, INV_REC, LIN, CALC_DT,v_cif_val,v_msg_txt);
 DUTY_VAL := 0;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_DUTY
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE GET_DUTY (CAN_COMMIT BOOLEAN) IS
 CIF_VAL NUMBER;
 DUTY_VAL NUMBER;
 NEED_COMMIT BOOLEAN := FALSE;
BEGIN
 IF DCLTN.CAN_CALC_DCLTN_FEES(:DCLTN_HDR2.PORT_CD, :DCLTN_HDR2.DCLTN_ISN) = 1 THEN
 LOCAL_GET_DUTY(CIF_VAL, DUTY_VAL);

 IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.CIF_COST <> CIF_VAL OR
 (:DCLTN_ITEMS.CIF_COST IS NULL AND CIF_VAL IS NOT NULL) OR
 (:DCLTN_ITEMS.CIF_COST IS NOT NULL AND CIF_VAL IS NULL) THEN
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.CIF_COST := CIF_VAL;
 NEED_COMMIT := TRUE;
 END IF; -- :DCLTN_ITEMS.CIF_COST <> CIF_VAL OR :DCLTN_ITEMS.CIF_COST IS NULL

 IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.ORGNL_DUTY <> DUTY_VAL OR :DCLTN_ITEMS.ORGNL_DUTY IS NULL THEN
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.ORGNL_DUTY := DUTY_VAL;
 NEED_COMMIT := TRUE;
 END IF; -- :DCLTN_ITEMS.ORGNL_DUTY <> DUTY_VALTORN:DCLTN_ITEMS.ORGNL_DUTY IS NULL

 IF NEED_COMMIT = TRUE AND CAN_COMMIT = TRUE THEN
 COMMIT;
 END IF;
 END IF; -- DCLTN.CAN_CALC_DCLTN_FEES(:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD, :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN) = TRUE
END;

 FROM SC_PORT_SETTING
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
--WHERE SYSOBJ_ID = DCLTN.DCLTN_SYS_ID
 WHERE SYSOBJ_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DCLTN_SYS_ID')
--&&& END
 AND VAR_NAME = 'BRKR_AUTO_PRINT'
 ;

 V_AUTO_PRINT_NBR := TO_NUMBER(V_AUTO_PRINT_CHR);

 IF V_AUTO_PRINT_NBR = 1 THEN
 RETURN TRUE;
 ELSE
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 RETURN TRUE;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ASSIGN_GROUP
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION ASSIGN_GROUP(V_GROUP_ID NUMBER DEFAULT NULL) RETURN NUMBER IS
--- BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM @ 27/12/2005
--- TO ASSIGIN GROUP ID TO DECLARATION AUTOMATICALLY.
BEGIN

 SELECT GRP_ID , GRP_NAME INTO :GROUP_ID , :L_DG_GRP_NAME FROM DCLTN_GRPS
 WHERE DCLTN_GRPS.PORT_CD = :dcltn_hdr2.PORT_CD
 AND
 GRP_ID = NVL(V_GROUP_ID,GRP_ID)
 AND
 DCLTN_GRPS.GRP_STATUS = 1
 AND
 (DCLTN_GRPS.PORT_CD,DCLTN_GRPS.GRP_ID) IN (SELECT PORT_CD,GRP_ID FROM GRP_DCLTN_TYPES
 WHERE REC_STATUS = 1 AND DCLTN_TYPE_ID= :DCLTN_TYPE_CD AND NVL(PRIVATE,0) = NVL(:PARAMETER.P_PRIVATE_VT,0));
 RETURN 0;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
 RETURN -1;
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 IF ( (:DCLTN_HDR2.PORT_CD = 98) OR (:DCLTN_HDR2.PORT_CD = 99) ) THEN
 RETURN 0;
 ELSE
 IF V_GROUP_ID IS NULL THEN
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21,155,'ERROR'); --- THIS STEP CALLED FROM WHEN_CRETE_RECORD
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 RETURN -2;
 ELSE
 RETURN -2; --- THIS STEP CALLED FROM WHEN_VALIDATE_ITEM
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DECLTN_LOV
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE DECLTN_LOV IS
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'DCLTN_PARAM';

 RET NUMBER;

 BEGIN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_TITLE', TEXT_PARAMETER, 'قائمة إختيار البيان');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'DCLTN_NBR', TEXT_PARAMETER, :DCLTN_HDR2.DCLTN_NBR);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'PORT_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, :DCLTN_HDR2.PORT_CD);
-- Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'DCLTN_TYPE_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, :DCLTN_HDR2.DCLTN_TYPE_CD); --
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'DCLTN_TYPE_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, :DCLTN_HDR2.DCLTN_TYPE_CD);

 IF ( (NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0) = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_SEC')) AND (:DCLTN_HDR2.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2)) )THEN
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'DCLTN_STA_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, 5);

 END IF;

 CALL_FORM('LOV_DCLTN.fmx',
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);

 IF :GLOBAL.DCLTN_NBR IS NOT NULL THEN
 :DCLTN_HDR2.DCLTN_ISN := :GLOBAL.DCLTN_ISN;
 :DCLTN_HDR2.DCLTN_NBR := :GLOBAL.DCLTN_NBR;
 :DCLTN_HDR2.DCLTN_DT := :GLOBAL.DCLTN_DT;
 ELSE
 :global.Exec_QRy_Now := 0;
 END IF;


 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' already exists!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CALL_SD_PORTS_LOV
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CALL_SD_PORTS_LOV(V_PORT_CD VARCHAR2, V_PORT_NAME VARCHAR2, V_PORT_TYPE VARCHAR2) IS
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'SD_PORT_LOV';
 RET NUMBER;
BEGIN
 :GLOBAL.PORT_CD := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.PORT_TYPE := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.PORT_NAME := NULL;

 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_TITLE', TEXT_PARAMETER, 'الجمارك السعوديه');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_WIDTH', TEXT_PARAMETER, 7.1);
 CALL_FORM('LOV_SD_PORTS.fmx',
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' already exists!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 IF :GLOBAL.PORT_CD IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF V_PORT_CD IS NOT NULL THEN
 COPY(:GLOBAL.PORT_CD, V_PORT_CD);
 END IF;

 IF V_PORT_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN
 COPY(:GLOBAL.PORT_NAME, V_PORT_NAME);
 END IF;

 IF V_PORT_TYPE IS NOT NULL THEN
 COPY(:GLOBAL.PORT_TYPE, V_PORT_TYPE);
 END IF;
 END IF;

END CALL_SD_PORTS_LOV;

 IF :GLOBAL.TYPE_ID IS NOT NULL THEN

Trigger.Name: KEY-F9
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$TES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
DECLARE
 PROP VARCHAR2(10);
 VIS VARCHAR2(200);
 V_FUN VARCHAR2(200);
BEGIN
 VIS := GET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', VISIBLE);
 V_FUN := GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('FUN_BUT',VISIBLE);

 IF VIS = 'TRUE' THEN
 SET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 GO_ITEM(NAME_IN('PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM'));
 COPY('', 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 ELSE
 IF V_FUN = 'TRUE' THEN
 COPY(NAME_IN('SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM'), 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 ADJ_FUNS;
 GO_ITEM('DUMMY');

 TMPLT.Populate_Functions;
 TMPLT.USING_KEYB := TRUE;
 TMPLT.CURSOR_AT := 1;
 TMPLT.KEYB_UP_DOWN(0);
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-HELP
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGHP$CALL_HELP_FORM */
/* Call the help system after setting globals with current block and item */
BEGIN
 :GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE := '';
 IF (:GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE IS NULL) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(23, 'Help file is missing or incorrect'), 'W', 'OFG', 23);
 ELSE
 :GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE := :GLOBAL.CG$HP_HPATH || '';
 BEGIN
 CGHP$CALL_MS_HELP(
 0 /* IN : Help Context Id */
 ,:GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE); /* IN : Help Resource File */
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
 END;
 END IF;
END;
